name: Campus Activewear Limited
summary: Campus Activewear Limited designs, makes, markets and distributes sports and athleisure footwear, apparel and backpacks in India and abroad, for men, women and kids. Its CAMPUS-branded range includes sports shoes for fitness and walking, casual footwear, sandals and slippers. Products are sold via e-commerce, distributors, retail and wholesale. Founded in 2005, it is based in Gurugram.
